main_theorem.statement: If X is scalar with density cap 1, U,V are independent R^2 random vectors independent of X with density caps M_U,M_V, M is invertible symmetric 2x2, d=a-g^T M^{-1}g is nonzero, and Q=aX^2+2X g^T(U+V)+(U+V)^T M(U+V)+affine, then Q has a continuous C0 density with ||p_Q||_infinity <= C0 (M_U M_V)^(2/5)|det M|^(-2/5)|d|^(-1/5), C0=5(3sqrt(6)/8)^(4/5)=4.67149102355819... . Equivalently the matrix factor is (|det M||det K|)^(-1/5) for K=[[a,g^T],[g,M]].
main_theorem.mechanism: Partner scalar L4 square-phase budget for the Schur scalar, followed by two-dimensional r-V Plancherel and L4-L4/3 frequency Holder. No pointwise Fresnel decay.

partner_result_used.actual_application: On partner strict-N3 family: 8*epsilon^(-1/2)*(epsilon^(-2))^(-1/4)=8; heavy-row branch 2^(11/4)=6.727171322... .

unresolved_implication: QFORM-SPECTRAL-COLOOP-NEARSINGULAR-TRANSVERSE-ROUTING-v1: route high-leverage/coloop states either to two source-disjoint 2D banks with controlled projection caps and controlled |det M||det K|, or route singular/nearly singular transverse compression to an existing rank-one/hyperbolic/pair-Schur/grouped/ridge/volume receiver without reciprocal tiny-minor payment; additional-spectrum same-bank phases also require dependence-safe reattachment.
